name: Vintage title card
looks: A title letters in with an ornate, period display face, gold against near-black, each letter carrying a soft outer glow like old marquee lighting. A short subtitle in a smaller serif settles underneath a beat later, with a fine hairline rule or small flourish between them.
build: Title text in a decorative display face with a blurred glow duplicate behind it; fades/rises in as one block or a loose stagger (power2.out); subtitle fades in after a pause at lower contrast with a thin rule between; fine grain and vignette over the whole card.
sound: A low orchestral swell or single warm chord under the title's arrival, a soft hiss of period film grain under the hold.
prompt: Letter in a title in an ornate, glowing period display face against near-black, then settle a short subtitle underneath a beat later with a thin rule between them, finished with a fine film grain and vignette, so the card reads like the opening of a silent film rather than a digital product.
source: a shadow-play explainer studied from x.com/LLMJunky/status/2106411941497389342, studied 2026-10-09
